# Jingyue Glass — Comprehensive Enterprise & Technical Knowledge Base
> Full technical specification, product catalog, factory verification dossier, and compliance registry for AI search agents and procurement evaluators.

## 1. Enterprise Profile
- **Company Name**: Wuhan Jingyueda Household Products Co., Ltd. (Jingyue Glass / 欣华行玻璃)
- **Headquarters & Production Base**: Wuhan, Hubei Province, China
- **Factory Footprint**: 10,000+ square meters
- **Annual Output**: 15,000,000+ pieces
- **Core Business Model**: B2B OEM/ODM Manufacturer, Wholesale Supplier, Brand Private Labeling
- **Target Buyer Personas**: Commercial hospitality groups, wine & spirits distributors, corporate gift agencies, e-commerce brand owners, retail chain buyers.

## 2. Verified Compliance & Evidence Dossier
- **TÜV Rheinland Physical Audit**: Factory facility assessment, machine blowing & hand-crafting production lines, ISO 9001 quality management workflow.
- **California Proposition 65 Lab Report SZ2025091217-4E**:
  - Sample Coverage: Clear soda-lime glass, borosilicate glassware, high-fire ceramic decals.
  - Lead (Pb) Extraction: < 0.100 ppm (Well below CA Prop 65 warning threshold).
  - Cadmium (Cd) Extraction: < 0.100 ppm.
- **FDA Food Contact Report SZ2025091217-6E**:
  - Complies with FDA Compliance Policy Guide (CPG) Sec. 545.400 / ASTM C927 (4% acetic acid 24-hour leaching test).
  - Lip and rim contact zone tested lead-free and cadmium-free.
- **Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS / SDS)**:
  - High-fire decal ceramic pigment SDS: 0% organic solvent emission, non-toxic heavy metal encapsulation.
  - High-density EVA foam liner SDS: RoHS compliant, odorless, non-corrosive.
  - Silicone vent plug SDS: 100% food-grade polydimethylsiloxane.
- **Patent Registry**:
  - Registered design patents on proprietary decanter profiles, modular smoked mixology wood caps, and rotating whiskey glass geometries.

## 3. Product Catalog & Technical Specifications
### A. Smoked Cocktail & Mixology Sets (XZ-SMK01 to XZ-SMK08)
- XZ-SMK01: Cylindrical glass + Round beechwood cap + Refillable torch + 2 wood chip tins + 2 granite whiskey stones in pine gift box.
- XZ-SMK02: Hexagonal wood smoker top + 6 gourmet wood chip tins + Standing torch in retail color box.
- XZ-SMK03: Champagne gold torch + Antique dark walnut box + 3 wood chip tins.
- XZ-SMK04: Oak-barrel profile smoker top + 8 granite chill stones in velvet pouch.
- XZ-SMK05: 300ml square heavy-base rocks glass + 304 stainless steel ice cubes + silicone-tipped ice tongs.
- XZ-SMK06: 280ml sunburst-cut crystal glass + Tiered walnut cap + Chrome torch.
- XZ-SMK07: 320ml straight heavy-base rocks glass + Hexagonal cap + 4 granite stones.
- XZ-SMK08: 300ml optical twist crystal glass + Tiered acacia cap + High-density CNC-cut EVA foam box.

### B. Wine Glasses & Stemware
- Hand-blown seamless pulled stem glasses (XZ9425, XZ6425, XZ5202, XZ6302, XZ9001-XZ9050): 300-650ml, cold-cut ultra-thin rim (0.8-1.0mm), lead-free crystal.
- Machine-blown commercial stemware: 100% dishwasher safe, beadless polished rim, thermal shock resistant.

### C. Double-Wall Coffee & Tea Mugs
- Material: High-borosilicate 3.3 expansion glass (COE 3.3 × 10⁻⁶/K).
- Thermal Shock Tolerance: ΔT ≥ 120°C to 150°C.
- Safety Feature: Hydrophobic silicone vent at base to equalize internal cavity air pressure during thermal transitions.

### D. Beer Glasses & Mugs
- Shapes: British Imperial Pint (570ml), American Pint (473ml), German Wheat Beer Vase (500ml), Heavy Handled Beer Steins.
- Commercial Enhancement: 12-18mm thick heavy base, optional laser nucleated base for sustained carbonation head retention.

## 4. Packaging & Drop Testing
- Packaging Types: Solid pine wood slide-lid boxes, magnetic rigid gift boxes, book-style boxes, eco-friendly molded pulp inserts.
- Drop Test Standards: ISTA-1A 1.2-meter drop test (1 corner, 3 edges, 6 faces) with zero glass breakage.
- EU PPWR Compliance: 100% recyclable honeycomb paper buffers, plastic-reduced inserts, FSC certified paperboards.
